copy_preview: That anchor is singing. Tell me you still have both Iron Seals before the bridge decides to become a ladder.
Both seals. One bad rib. And a professional opinion that we should stop standing on the thing that is singing.

copy_units.text: That anchor is singing. Tell me you still have both Iron Seals before the bridge decides to become a ladder.
Both seals. One bad rib. And a professional opinion that we should stop standing on the thing that is singing.

copy_preview: Professional opinion revised. The bridge has a landlord, and it looks offended by our rent.

copy_units.text: Professional opinion revised. The bridge has a landlord, and it looks offended by our rent.

copy_preview: One intact anchor behind us. One boss ahead. If it reaches the center, the bridge twists and the lift stays sealed.

copy_units.text: One intact anchor behind us. One boss ahead. If it reaches the center, the bridge twists and the lift stays sealed.

copy_preview: Then it never reaches center. Read the legs; I will make the head believe I am the problem.

copy_units.text: Then it never reaches center. Read the legs; I will make the head believe I am the problem.

copy_preview: Now, Elian. I can redirect the charge, not negotiate with it.

copy_units.text: Now, Elian. I can redirect the charge, not negotiate with it.

copy_preview: THOOM
The ankle seam is real, but it only stays loaded for six seconds. That is less generous than I hoped.

copy_preview: Six seconds is a career in salvage. Move before the profession changes its mind.

copy_units.text: Six seconds is a career in salvage. Move before the profession changes its mind.

copy_preview: Contact never happened. Forelimb changed angle after the jaw clamp—remember that when it comes again.

copy_units.text: Contact never happened. Forelimb changed angle after the jaw clamp—remember that when it comes again.

copy_preview: Stop turning injuries into field notes. Your breath is folding at the collarbone, and I cannot shield you from inside.
You can shield the bridge. I need one complete pattern and something hot enough to force the second circuit.

copy_units.text: Stop turning injuries into field notes. Your breath is folding at the collarbone, and I cannot shield you from inside.

copy_preview: That talisman was our exit plan.
It was a possibility. You are an actual person holding a boss by the teeth. I am spending the possibility.

copy_units.text: That talisman was our exit plan.

copy_preview: Three broken breaths taught me where the fourth one had to go.

copy_preview: We kept the anchor, lost the talisman, and gained a key that wants to redesign my career. That feels aggressively fair.

copy_preview: The rib is not a metaphor. You cannot breathe around it forever just because the Ledger has not objected yet.
I was hoping the dignified silence would imply recovery. Apparently it only implies poor medical judgment.

copy_preview: Retreat meant crossing the same broken chain with less Qi, fewer options, and a waking bell below us.

copy_preview: Do not choose the dangerous class because pain made the safer one feel cowardly. Choose it only if it changes the next fight.
The Appraiser would tell us what the ruins are worth. The Adept might tell us where the ruins intend to kill us.

copy_preview: Keep the seal. I would rather fight with a bent plan than watch you purchase one clean minute.

copy_preview: That pulse is climbing toward the city.
Then our volume problem is no longer getting out. It is reaching the crown before the bell does.

Then choose after you can see the price clearly. For once, let tomorrow make its own bad decision.
